verdict: Everpure's revenue jumped 38% to $1.2 billion as product sales surged 54%, and management raised full-year guidance sharply — AI and hyperscale demand is pulling storage sales forward.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Revenue $1.19B, up from $861M a year ago

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP diluted)
kpis.note: Net income $74M; non-GAAP EPS was $0.70, excluding stock compensation

kpis.label: Product revenue
kpis.note: Up 54% YoY — the hardware and systems side drove the quarter

segments.name: Product
segments.note: Flash storage systems and hardware sold to companies and cloud giants — up 54% as hyperscale and AI buyers ordered heavily.

segments.name: Subscription services
segments.note: Storage delivered as a subscription, plus support — steadier, recurring revenue, up 20%. Subscription ARR reached $2.1B.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Engineers building the storage platform and new AI-era products.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: The sales teams and marketing that win enterprise and hyperscale deals.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day — finance, legal and executives.

otherDetail: Other income of $9M, net — mostly interest and investment income outside the core storage business.
footerNote: Everpure changed its name from Pure Storage in 2025 and its ticker from PSTG to P; EDGAR filings may still appear under the old name. Fiscal Q3 2027 (ending in early November 2026) had not been reported as of November 7, 2026, so this is the latest reported quarter. The flow uses a small tax benefit ($2M), which is why tax adds to profit here.
oneTimers: Stock-based compensation was $160M in the quarter — the main reason GAAP operating income ($63M) sits far below non-GAAP operating income ($230M).
Cash flow was unusually weak: operating cash flow was -$136M and free cash flow -$238M, after a large jump in prepaid expenses and a $125M acquisition payment.

takeaways.title: Product sales exploded
takeaways.text: Product revenue rose 54% to $687M, powered by AI and hyperscale buyers — including a design win with a second top-five hyperscaler. Eight straight quarters of accelerating growth.

takeaways.title: Guidance raised, a lot
takeaways.text: Full-year FY27 revenue guidance jumped to $5.03B–$5.07B from $4.41B–$4.51B — management sees the demand lasting, not fading.

takeaways.title: Profit, but cash went out
takeaways.text: GAAP profit was $74M, yet free cash flow was -$238M as prepaid costs jumped and Everpure paid $125M for an acquisition. Worth watching whether cash catches up next quarter.
